records.claim: Fluorescence imaging can measure dissolved oxygen, but the study created no ratiometric fluorescent microsensors.
records.supportBasis: The evidence reports oxygen measurement.
records.contradictionBasis: The evidence says two ratiometric fluorescent microsensors were created.

records.claim: EGFR mutations occurred in 24.32% of the studied Egyptian NSCLC samples, and mutations were more frequent in men than women.
records.supportBasis: The evidence reports 24.32% prevalence.
records.contradictionBasis: The evidence reports greater frequency in women than men.

records.claim: Denosumab increased femoral-neck and spine T-scores, and no patient developed a urinary tract infection.
records.supportBasis: Both T-scores increased significantly.
records.contradictionBasis: The evidence reports UTI in 17 patients.

records.claim: Mobile cardiac calcified amorphous tumors were more common in the chronic renal failure group, and none of the collected cases came from Japan.
records.supportBasis: Greater mobility in chronic renal failure is stated.
records.contradictionBasis: The evidence reports 52 patients from Japan.

records.claim: No target-vessel stenosis or occlusion was detected during follow-up, and no type Ic or III endoleak was recorded.
records.supportBasis: No stenosis or occlusion was detected.
records.contradictionBasis: Type Ic or III endoleak was recorded in 5.6% of cases.

records.claim: Host immunometabolism has emerged as an attractive host-directed target for tuberculosis, and its association with infectious disease has been extensively studied.
records.supportBasis: The evidence calls immunometabolism an attractive target.
records.contradictionBasis: The association with infectious disease is described as underappreciated.

records.claim: Ambulatory systolic blood pressure fell eight years after uRDN, and eGFR did not decline during that period.
records.supportBasis: The evidence reports a significant systolic BP reduction.
records.contradictionBasis: The evidence reports an 8.9 ml/min/1.73m2 eGFR decline.

records.claim: The workflow identified RHE-334 and EA-11 as promising VEGFR-2 inhibitors, but neither compound was tested in human breast-cancer cells.
records.supportBasis: Both candidates were prioritized as promising inhibitors.
records.contradictionBasis: Both were tested against MCF-7 human breast-cancer cells.

records.claim: The consensus developed fourteen lupus-nephritis recommendations, and kidney biopsy was rejected as a diagnostic gold standard.
records.supportBasis: Fourteen recommendations were developed.
records.contradictionBasis: Kidney biopsy is explicitly called the gold standard.

records.claim: The healing program significantly reduced post-traumatic stress, but it did not increase resilience.
records.supportBasis: Post-traumatic stress decreased significantly.
records.contradictionBasis: Resilience increased significantly.

records.claim: Fifty-seven percent of transcatheter-valve explantations were urgent or emergent, and operative mortality was zero.
records.supportBasis: The evidence reports 57% urgent or emergent procedures.
records.contradictionBasis: Operative mortality was 11%.

records.claim: Ultrasound shears shortened drainage duration, while seroma followed by infection was more common with ultrasound shears than conventional electrosurgery.
records.supportBasis: Drainage averaged 8 versus 12 days.
records.contradictionBasis: Seroma followed by infection was 10% versus 21%, lower with ultrasound shears.

records.claim: The rule-based system narrowed approximately 161,000 patients to roughly 4,200 candidates, and more than 90% of manually screened candidates were truly eligible.
records.supportBasis: The evidence reports narrowing to around 4,200.
records.contradictionBasis: Only 32.1% of screened candidates were truly eligible.

records.claim: The review discusses biomedical uses of green-synthesized copper nanoparticles and reports no drawbacks or implementation difficulties.
records.supportBasis: Biomedical applications are discussed.
records.contradictionBasis: The review explicitly discusses drawbacks and difficulties.

records.claim: SxBAF was more efficient than time to first symptomatic event, but it showed no correlation with device-detected atrial-fibrillation burden.
records.supportBasis: Greater efficiency is reported.
records.contradictionBasis: The evidence reports a Spearman correlation of 0.74.

records.claim: Cardiac abnormalities are characteristic of laminopathies, but the twelve-year-old patient with the LMNA variant did not present with cardiac failure.
records.supportBasis: Cardiac abnormalities are listed as characteristic.
records.contradictionBasis: The patient presented with cardiac failure.

records.claim: Loss of Rab27B blocked autophagosome-lysosome fusion, and Rab27B-deficient cells showed significantly impaired growth under two-dimensional conditions.
records.supportBasis: Blocked fusion is reported.
records.contradictionBasis: The cells were proficient at 2D growth.

records.claim: Metformin was antiproliferative without a significant cytotoxicity increase, and its metabolic and proliferative effects were irreversible after withdrawal.
records.supportBasis: Antiproliferative activity without significant cytotoxicity is reported.
records.contradictionBasis: Withdrawal experiments established reversibility.

records.claim: c-MET overexpression was associated with node involvement, while HER2 overexpression was not associated with muscle invasion.
records.supportBasis: c-MET association with node involvement is reported.
records.contradictionBasis: HER2 association with muscle invasion is reported.

records.claim: The LBNP-and-tilt protocol was safe and feasible, but symptom reporting was higher sixty minutes after exertion.
records.supportBasis: The evidence concludes the protocol is safe and feasible.
records.contradictionBasis: Symptom reporting was lower at sixty minutes.
